messages:
devex-liz: Heads-up — quick docs batch I want to ship today. Small link fixes + two short frontmatter updates. Putting a checklist below; please claim items you can fix. ETA EOD if possible. TL;DR: broken shortlinks in /kb, replace old runtime example paths, rehost one runbook image, and assign owners for orphan anchors.

Checklist:
• Fix kb shortlink: /kb/old-embed -> /kb/embed-guide
• Replace example curl in runtime/quickstart (broken path)
• Rehost image in runbook: /media/runbook/late-2023.png -> CDN/S3 location
• Assign owners for orphan anchors found in scan

If you claim an item, reply with the bullet you take and a quick PR link when ready. @anya-docs can coordinate reviews.

sam-eng: I'll take the curl example replacement (runtime/quickstart). Will open PR in ~30m. FYI found the snippet in two places.

anya-docs: thanks, sam. I'll review. quick note: prefer canonical link style (no trailing slash) to avoid redirects.

kevin-platform: I'll rehost the image and update the URL. uploading to CDN now — will post new link here when uploaded.

mira-pm: I can triage the orphan anchors list — have a spreadsheet? any priority ones?

devex-liz: sending the scan export in thread — pasted the top offenders below. Prioritize 'deploy-runbook' and 'kv-cache' anchors. Quick sed suggestion if you're doing multiple files locally (run on a feature branch, not main):

```bash
# replace old embed shortlink across repo (example)
rg "(\\/kb\\/old-embed)" -l | xargs sed -i "s\\/\\/kb\\/old-embed\\/\\/\\/kb\\/embed-guide\\/g"
```

Please run locally and open PR; add a short PR description pointing to this thread.

sam-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2467 — replaced curl path in runtime/quickstart and runtime/examples, fixed an extra backtick. cc @anya-docs

ci-bot: build passed for PR #2467 — docs lint OK :white_check_mark:

anya-docs: reviewed, left one nit about H2 -> H3 nesting. merging after small tweak.

kevin-platform: uploaded asset to CDN: https://cdn.redwood.ai/media/runbook/2024-late.png — PR #2469 opened to update the image path in runbook and runbook index.

mira-pm: spreadsheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 — I marked priority rows and added quick notes for context.

devex-liz: perfect — thanks all. tagging this for sprint board: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/KB-4511. If anyone can't hit EOD, ping here and we'll reassign. :rocket:
